# anthropic_invite (Data Source)

Reads one organization invitation by id. Works with any admin or enterprise credential.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "anthropic_invite" "example" {
  id = "invite_01ExampleInviteId000000000"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) Invite id (`invite_...`).

### Read-Only

- `accepted_at` (String) Timestamp the invite was accepted; null until then.
- `email` (String) Invited email address.
- `expires_at` (String) Timestamp the invite expires.
- `invited_at` (String) Timestamp the invite was sent.
- `rbac_group_ids` (List of String) Claude Enterprise RBAC group ids assigned on acceptance.
- `role` (String) Organization role granted on acceptance.
- `status` (String) `pending`, `accepted`, `expired` or `deleted`.
